translations.web: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
translations.bsb: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
translations.kjv: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.
